definitions.explanation: Used to add more information or emphasize an increase in degree.
Indicates an increase beyond the current state.

examples.japanese: {更|さら}に{一|ひと}つ{言|い}いたい。
examples.english: I have one more thing to say.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}り、{更|さら}に{風|かぜ}も{強|つよ}くなった。
examples.english: It rained, and furthermore, the wind grew stronger.

examples.japanese: この{本|ほん}は{面白|おもしろ}い。{更|さら}に、{絵|え}もきれいだ。
examples.english: This book is interesting. Moreover, the illustrations are beautiful.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}は{新|あたら}しい{店|みせ}を{出|だ}し、{更|さら}に{海外|かいがい}にも{進出|しんしゅつ}した。
examples.english: The company opened new stores and, furthermore, expanded overseas.

examples.japanese: {今回|こんかい}の{調査|ちょうさ}では{新|あたら}しいデータが{得|え}られた。{更|さら}に、{今|いま}までの{結果|けっか}を{見直|みなお}す{必要|ひつよう}もある。
examples.english: New data was obtained in this survey. Additionally, there is a need to review the results so far.

examples.japanese: {値段|ねだん}が{更|さら}に{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: The price went up even more.

examples.japanese: {更|さら}に{詳|くわ}しく{説明|せつめい}します。
examples.english: I will explain in even more detail.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{成功|せいこう}し、{更|さら}に{有名|ゆうめい}になった。
examples.english: He succeeded and became even more famous.

examples.japanese: {練習|れんしゅう}を{続|つづ}ければ、{更|さら}に{上手|じょうず}になれると{思|おも}う。
examples.english: If you keep practicing, I think you can get even better.

examples.japanese: {技術|ぎじゅつ}が{進|すす}んで、{生活|せいかつ}は{更|さら}に{便利|べんり}になっていくだろう。
examples.english: As technology advances, life will become even more convenient.

notes:
USAGE: {更|さら}に can introduce additional information (like "moreover") or indicate an increase in degree (like "even more").

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{更|さら}に〜する (to do ~ even more)
・{更|さら}に{詳|くわ}しく (in more detail)
・{更|さら}に{加|くわ}えて (in addition to that)

CONTRAST:
・{更|さら}に - furthermore, even more (formal)
・もっと - more (general, casual)
・その{上|うえ} - on top of that, moreover
・しかも - moreover, what's more
